description: PHP frontend template data passed to render(); arrays are presentation inputs, not stable database models.
conventions: render() exposes the supplied page variables to the main template, header/footer, and render_partial(); a partial's own data overrides inherited page context.

Raw database columns keep PDO's scalar representation (commonly int|string); do not rely on numeric strings or implicit truthiness. The explicitly normalized booleans and HTML fields below are stable PHP types.
Nullable values are null when the related record/value does not exist; optional page variables can be absent on branch-specific paths.
Escape text and attribute values with e(). Only contentHtml (core-rendered/sanitized) and pluginHtml (trusted output from an active plugin provider) are HTML values.
Page variables are template context, not a database/API compatibility promise. Use declared userData for optional user-center queries and a theme provider for custom workflows.

fields.title: string
fields.content: string; source body, not rendered HTML; blank for password-protected articles
fields.custom_fields: string|null; legacy raw JSON for compatibility, null for password-protected articles; prefer normalized customFields on post detail
fields.is_password_protected: bool; verifier is never supplied to list templates
fields.comment_count: database integer; approved comments including replies
fields.recent_comments: list<{author_name:string,content:string,created_at:string}>; at most 6 approved root comments, empty for password-protected articles

postDetail.description: Allowlisted public content view. Password hashes, author email, moderation internals, and soft-delete fields are omitted.

fields.title: string
fields.meta_description: string; absent while the article is locked

userPost.description: Public article summary returned by the user center; protected excerpt is blank and only a boolean protection flag is included.

page.description: Public page row; status and deleted_at are omitted.

commentNode.description: Normalized visible comment tree node; author email and moderation status are not exposed.

fields.userId: string; empty string for anonymous commenter
fields.avatar: string; safe resolved URL, including local default avatar
fields.isPending: bool; true only for a pending comment visible to this viewer

microItem.description: Normalized public micro-post payload; a logged-in author may also receive their own private items.

fields.isPrivate: bool; private items are only returned to their author
fields.author: {id:string|null,name:string,avatarUrl:string|null}

currentUser.description: current_user() profile allowlist. Authentication hashes, reset credentials, and disabled state are omitted.

index.summary: Home article list, unless a published page is configured as the homepage.

post.summary: Article detail. Locked article paths deliberately omit body and private verifier fields.

fields.contentHtml: trusted rendered HTML string; empty while locked
fields.passwordError: optional string; only set after a failed password attempt
fields.title: string
fields.theme: object of active theme's declared settings
fields.prevPost: optional {title:string,slug:string}|null; not supplied on locked paths
fields.nextPost: optional {title:string,slug:string}|null; not supplied on locked paths

page.summary: Standalone page and configured homepage page.

fields.pluginHtml: trusted plugin-rendered HTML string; empty when no plugin renderer handles the template
fields.title: string

search.summary: Search results; an empty keyword yields an empty list.

archives.summary: Chronological archive grouped by localized month.

micro.summary: Public micro-post list, including private posts only for their signed-in author.

user.summary: Theme-owned user center. Guest access is allowed; requested data is controlled by theme.json userData.

fields.user: currentUser-shaped object; empty object for guests
fields.posts: list<userPost>; requested by userData.posts, otherwise empty
fields.pointsEnabled: bool; true only when userData.points is requested and the points ledger exists
fields.pointsBalance: int; zero when pointsEnabled is false
fields.pointTransactions: list<{amount,reason,reference_type:string|null,reference_id:database integer|null,created_at}>; empty when points are unavailable
fields.title: string

auth.summary: Standalone login, registration, password-recovery and reset page; does not use the blog shell.

fields.subtitle: string
fields.showRegister: optional bool; passed on login/register modes
fields.requireVerify: optional bool; passed on register mode

error.summary: Safe public error page; never receives exception details.

header.summary: Site shell entry; rendered through get_header() with the current page context inherited.

fields.title: optional string
fields.jsonLd: optional array/object accepted by frontend_meta filter

footer.summary: Site shell closing layout; rendered through get_footer() with the current page context inherited.

fields.pageContext: the active page variables described by its main template

post-card.summary: Article listing card used by home, taxonomy, search and optional user center templates.

fields.post: postListItem or userPost; absent summary fields should be read with ??

fields.page: int; current page, clamped to at least 1
fields.baseUrl: string; page parameter is appended by the component

related-posts.summary: Optional related article list; password-protected excerpts are blank.

comment-section.summary: Top-level comment component; form visibility and comment totals may differ when comments are disabled.

fields.postId: int; post target compatibility field, zero for page-only usage
fields.targetType: optional string: post|page; defaults to post
fields.post: object with slug:string when using the default URL fallback

comment-form.summary: Standalone comment form or nested reply form.

fields.targetType: optional string: post|page; defaults to post
fields.parentId: string|null; null for a root comment
fields.compact: optional bool; true for nested reply form

comment-thread.summary: Renders the normalized visible comment tree and optional reply forms.

fields.targetType: optional string: post|page; defaults to post
